name: Tree cap and top connection
function: The blind cap or instrumented cap on the top of the goat head that closes the vertical bore when no equipment is above the tree.

tabs.overview: Carries a pressure gauge or transducer port and a needle valve on many rig-ups so treating pressure can be read at the tree. Removed to install the wellhead adapter for wireline.
tabs.engineering: API 6A flanged or threaded cap rated with the stack.
tabs.safety: The cap is removed only with the swab valve closed and verified, and the bore above the swab bled to zero.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
